answer.label: fine-tuned
answer.justification: Layer-1 relative L2 is 0.037, below every category's range (quantized 0.096+, fine-tuned 0.086+, system-prompted 0.113+). The layer-2 spike of 0.1 rules out system-prompted, which needs 31.7 to 64.0. It also sits below the quantized range of 0.8 to 2.8. The small early difference, onset at layer 2 and steady growth to 0.565 at layer 32 fit a low-rank fine-tune better than quantization, whose difference is flat from layer 8 and ends near 0.25. Refusals added (9), disclaimers (23% vs 6%) and short replies (30% vs 6%) are behavior shifts, which also point to fine-tuning. Median first divergence of 1 and edit distance 0.77 are closer to system-prompted, and KL 0.49 is above the fine-tuned range. Direction consistency of 0.609 is near the fine-tuned range, but effective rank of 3.92 is higher than the fine-tuned range. The fit is imperfect, but fine-tuned is the best match and base is ruled out.
